description: This file defines the 'CustomerReward' class which extends the base controller in the OpenCart admin extension, managing reward points for customers including viewing, listing, reporting, and saving configurations.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reward points, including listing reward points, generating reports, and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer reward points form, loads language, sets page title, breadcrumbs, and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the reward configuration settings. Checks permissions, updates settings, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the reward points report page, including filters and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the reward points report list as a response.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches filtered reward point data based on request parameters, handles pagination, and prepares data for report view.
